title: Gift of irish mystery
body:
The Gift of Irish mystery

"Unwrappable 2 days before the end of the event 2025 Irish event! Will not return to stores."

This gift is sold at the Rainbow End Saint Patrick's day event place. you are able to open it 2 days before the event ends.

What is inside?

What's inside is an item called Grimble's Green Grape Soda, when picked up it can be interacted with and will turn the player into a small leprechaun.
